source_note: 依据寺院官网正面实照重绘现存南大门，不画东大寺大佛殿。寺院明确1199年上梁、1203年与金刚力士像同时竣工；建筑为入母屋造五间三户二重门，大佛样。18大柱是整体柱数，不是正面柱数；实景正面六柱形成五间，中央三间为通道。

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.

Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


Subject: ONLY the Nandaimon (Great South Gate) of Todaiji Temple, Nara, Japan (东大寺南大门), rebuilt1199–1203 in the Japanese Daibutsuyo style. Image1 is the Buddha STYLE MASTER ONLY. Image2 is the verified actual frontal official photograph of this gate and is the geometry authority. Preserve its Japanese medieval gate silhouette, exposed massive wooden structure and restrained roof shape; do not turn it into a Chinese palace, a pagoda or a closed Buddha hall.
Draw the entire gate approximately straight-on, verticals vertical, minimal perspective, complete ridge-to-stair silhouette. It has EXACTLY TWO broad hipped-and-gabled tiled roof levels (Japanese irimoya), whose deep projecting eaves dominate the horizontal silhouette; the upper roof is only slightly narrower than the lower level. Preserve the shallow visible roof planes, broad exposed undersides with layered horizontal timber beams and projecting bracket arms, the long plain ridge, and modest raised tips visible in the photograph. No third roof, no lower mokoshi apron, no balcony railing, no central finial, no massive dragon roof ornaments.
The front has EXACTLY SIX large round timber columns creating FIVE bays. The THREE CENTRAL BAYS are tall OPEN PASSAGEWAYS, and the TWO END BAYS are enclosed timber compartments for guardian statues: solid low timber panels with small vertical lattice screens above. Do not draw five open doors. Keep all THREE open passages as WHITE empty space with only a few structural depth lines; remove all landscape and distant buildings seen through them. Do not add a column at the center axis. The gate has18major columns TOTAL in depth; do not depict18columns across the front. Preserve the continuous verticality of the tall shafts, the conspicuous horizontal tie-beam courses penetrating and tying the frame, and the bracket arms protruding from the column lines. Use lightly outlined wood, no filled black timber or shadow.
At the center between the two eave levels, keep the simple rectangular shape of the suspended horizontal plaque but make it BLANK, with no Chinese or Japanese text. Keep a simple low stone foundation and broad central shallow stairway. Remove the front lanterns and their small canopy stands, people, trees, signs, lamps, fences, ropes, wall surroundings and all neighboring architecture. Do not add visible guardian figures outside the two end compartments.
Visual density must match the sparse Buddha mother image: exterior contours slightly stronger, a few fine internal structural lines, every broad surface pure WHITE. Within each tiled roof plane use ONLY6 to8 separated directional strokes, no every-tile grid. Under the eaves, show just the main beam and bracket outline without repeated dense rafter hatch. Wood panels have at most2to3 spaced seams. Lattice screens have only6to8 fine vertical strokes. Keep no woodgrain or grey shading. Full canvas1536x1024 landscape. Reduce the whole gate to fit comfortably within x=150 to x=1386, about80percent of the canvas width, centered; full upper and lower roof tips, foundation edges, and stair foot uncut, clear white around every edge.
caption: 东大寺 · 南大门正面
镰仓时代 · 1199—1203年重建

historical_sources.supports: 1199年上梁、1203年与仁王像同时竣工；重源重建，大佛样；入母屋造、五间三户二重门，18根大圆柱、门高25.46米。
historical_sources.note: 中文页将大佛样误写为“大佛像”，本条按建筑术语规范为大佛样；1199上梁与1203竣工分别记录。

site_recommendation.name: 东大寺
site_recommendation.year_note: 1199为上梁年，1203为门与金刚力士像竣工年；时间轴用1203，非东大寺8世纪初创年。
site_recommendation.place: 日本 · 奈良县 · 奈良市
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 南大门类别公开点位34°41′08.84″N、135°50′23.28″E换算；公开地图近似位置。
site_recommendation.lede: 南大门以贯通高处的圆柱和层层横贯的梁木显出大佛样的结构力量。三条通道穿过宽阔的两重屋檐下，两侧仁王像守住通往东大寺的入口。
facts: 现存南大门由重源主持重建，1199年上梁，1203年与门内金刚力士像同时竣工。
山门采用入母屋造（歇山顶），正面五间、中央三户，具有两重屋檐，是大佛样建筑的重要遗存。
全门共有18根大圆柱，正面六柱划分五间；据寺院资料，门高自基坛以上为25.46米。
